name: disable_animated_screen_filter

notes: func_00103730 clears renderer-enable flag D_002B8C84. The main per-frame callback func_00100328 schedules func_00103188 through func_001036F0 only while this flag is nonzero, so clearing it stops the animated 16-strip screen filter enabled by command 539 enable_animated_screen_filter.
